offer.name: Fixture-verified JSON normalization for repeatable data workflows
offer.scope: Validate one narrow JSON record transformation for an independent customer, using authorized redacted or synthetic examples and a fixed acceptance fixture, then propose self-service delivery through an Apify Actor.
currentCapabilities: A local open-source dashboard and CLI generate a bounded declarative ToolSpec using an installed provider CLI.
The trusted runtime supports field mapping, string trimming and case normalization, supported type conversion, deduplication, and sorting within its allowlist.
Independent fixtures check expected JSON output before Actor packaging.
The repository documents one public catalog-normalization Actor and an earlier checked cloud publication; this plan does not reverify its live state.
The local ledger separates pending amounts, receipts, and costs; it does not independently verify payment.
proposedOnly: A deployed self-service intake and asynchronous AI-operated commercial workflow
A minimal customer-led improvement selected only after three authorized samples
A row-level diagnostic or audit report, if a real sample demonstrates demand and a separate acceptance fixture verifies the feature
Activated creator monetization, paying-customer telemetry, and automated settlement reconciliation
exclusions: No resale of subscription quota, provider account access, or credentials
No promise of profit, remaining-quota measurement, or guaranteed revenue
No claim that CSV ingestion or Shopify-ready exports, Shopify-specific support, or row-level audit reporting is already implemented
No customer-data scraping, source-system credentials, private personal data, or production write access required for this validation
No external messages, live posts, customer runs, paid services, billing changes, or schedules are authorized by this preparation-only manifest

actions: After separate execution authorization, have AI inspect owned-account, channel, billing, cost-control, intake, and evidence readiness without changing fees or buying services.
Record the current Actor build, actual pricing, ownership, and initial counts; retain unknown values as unknown.
Keep n8n, Make, and Hacker News forums read-only and all unverified bot routes disabled.
If readiness is delayed, shift the actual 14-day window; do not count preparation days as customer exposure.
requiredEvidence: Actual start date or blocked status
Approved execution scope if a later launch is requested
days.stopCondition: Do not launch while this manifest is preparation_only or any execution flag is false. If platform identity or account intervention is required, mark that dependency BLOCKED and continue only independent local preparation.

actions: Prepare an owned landing document explaining the narrow JSON outcome, actual limitations, example results, and hypothetical fixed price.
Prepare a maximum-five-question asynchronous intake with a sample-use authorization field and synthetic/redacted sample guidance.
Define anonymous cohort and source identifiers without collecting credentials, payment details, or unnecessary personal data.
requiredEvidence: Implemented and authorized intake endpoint before any future publication
days.stopCondition: Keep the landing and intake as drafts until their actual hosting, permissions, and execution authorization are established; do not direct users to an unimplemented endpoint.

actions: Prepare one native-JSON before/after fixture and a reproducible local walkthrough using supported transformations.
Prepare optional n8n/Make integration examples in the owned repository without claiming official approval or community publication.
Prepare the Actor's searchable title and schemas and a no-charge MCP discovery check for a later authorized execution phase.
requiredEvidence: Discovery evidence only if later authorized and actually checked
days.stopCondition: Do not publish untested examples, claim unverified MCP visibility, run paid Actors, or post generated content to forums that prohibit it.

actions: During a separately authorized live phase, have AI process voluntary inbound answers and permitted business-channel replies toward ten qualified asynchronous conversations.
Use at most five questions to capture recurring job, present workaround, desired output, frequency or scale, and willingness to test the disclosed price.
Prepare personalized outreach drafts only for individually verified suitable business channels; keep them unsent unless outreach has been explicitly authorized.
requiredEvidence: Actual reply or opt-in reference for each conversation
Evidence of channel permission before any outbound action
Separate counts for researched leads and responding prospects
days.stopCondition: Do not treat a researched company, inferred pain point, generated persona, or unanswered draft as a conversation. Unknown route permission keeps outbound disabled.

actions: Collect up to three independently supplied, expressly authorized redacted or synthetic JSON samples during an authorized live phase.
Have AI compare desired outcomes and choose only one minimal supported change that addresses the repeated job.
If a requested feature is outside current capabilities, document it as proposed until implemented and independently verified.
requiredEvidence: Three sample-use authorization references or an explicit shortfall
Agreed expected output for each fixture
One selected improvement with a rejection list for unrelated requests
days.stopCondition: Do not use unauthorized or sensitive production samples, invent customer samples, or select a broader feature on the assumption that three real samples exist.

actions: Have AI implement only the selected bounded improvement, if samples and scope support it.
Run the same independent input and expected-output fixtures without rewriting expectations to make implementation pass.
Prepare a reproducible JSON result and a concise explanation of supported and rejected inputs.
days.stopCondition: Stop delivery on any fixture mismatch, unsupported transformation, missing sample authorization, or scope expansion requiring unimplemented capabilities.

actions: Verify the proposed delivery path against the same authorized fixture data and exact output contract.
Prepare self-service instructions, run-size limits, failure guidance, and a clear spending-limit explanation.
Record local checks separately from any future authorized cloud acceptance run, build publication, or customer delivery.
requiredEvidence: Exact build reference for any actual cloud check
Cost estimate and error handling evidence
days.stopCondition: A local pass does not authorize deployment or spending. Block the cloud-dependent path if it lacks explicit authorization or if the exact delivered build is unverified.

actions: Prepare one fixed cohort quote: USD 0.01 per start plus USD 0.002 per delivered record, subject to actual platform configuration and disclosures.
Only after separate authorization and billing readiness, allow prospective customers to see the actual live price and decide independently whether to run the Actor.
Record qualified explicit offers separately from page visits, free trials, and expressions of interest.
requiredEvidence: Actual active pricing evidence if later enabled
Offer denominators and independent prospect decisions
No self-funded purchase in the cohort
days.stopCondition: Keep pricing hypothetical while monetization is unactivated. Do not configure billing, increase live prices, send quotes, or initiate any paid run under this draft manifest.

actions: During a future authorized live phase, have AI observe up to five independently initiated self-service trials and answer opted-in technical questions through permitted channels.
Record completion, useful output, eligible actual charges, run cost, and reasons for failure without requesting customer credentials.
Separate free-plan tests from eligible independent paid-plan use.
days.stopCondition: Never create a purchase on a customer's behalf without their instruction, pay with the project owner's money to simulate demand, or count a charged free-plan event as creator revenue.

actions: Reconcile independent eligible paid use against delivered records, actual charges, refunds, and platform evidence.
Keep provisional event revenue, estimated net earnings, settled platform amounts, and cash receipts in separate fields.
Keep the cohort price fixed and diagnose delivery or positioning problems without inventing a successful payment.
days.stopCondition: Do not report a paying customer without positive actual eligible charge and accessible delivery evidence; do not report cash without a real receipt.

actions: Observe whether a paying customer independently returns for a distinct useful job or dataset.
Prepare one optional 48-hour follow-up only for an opted-in recipient on a verified permitted route.
Stop follow-up after a refusal, opt-out, or the single reminder; do not schedule or send it in preparation mode.
requiredEvidence: Suppression or opt-out record when applicable
days.stopCondition: A retry, owner-triggered rerun, same-job failure recovery, or incentivized purchase is not repeat demand. No reminder may be sent without route permission and explicit outbound authorization.

actions: Classify actual voluntary objections as price, missing feature, trust, no recurring need, existing free workaround, or distribution mismatch.
Compare real customer statements with observed behavior and separate unobserved assumptions.
Prepare the next minimal experiment without modifying the current cohort price or overstating an unimplemented feature.
days.stopCondition: Do not infer that silence is a price objection, repeatedly contact nonresponders, or treat generated objections as customer evidence.

actions: Deduplicate customer identities and exclude owner, test, subsidized, refunded, failed-delivery, and unverified paid-use records from success counts as appropriate.
Calculate per-delivery economics using actual eligible fees and measured costs, keeping unknown costs visible.
Prepare counts and denominators for visits, qualified conversations, samples, trials, offers, paying customers, and repeat customers.
days.stopCondition: Do not claim positive margin with incomplete material costs or demand conversion without a trustworthy denominator.

actions: Produce an evidence-linked report for the actual 14-day window, or a preparation/readiness report if the campaign never launched.
Compare the cohort against three independent paying customers and one genuine repeat customer, with delivery and economics evidence.
Mark insufficient traffic, too few qualified offers, unresolved billing, or incomplete eligibility evidence as inconclusive rather than no demand.
Recommend continue, narrow/pivot, extend distribution, or stop based on the decision rules; create no new schedule or outbound work automatically.
requiredEvidence: Linked independent paid and repeat evidence
Decision with limits and next proposed scope
days.stopCondition: Do not declare commercial validation from likes, public user counts, promises, free trials, self-funded runs, or unreceived payouts; do not execute a follow-on campaign without separate authorization.

readiness.requirement: Separate authorization for an actual launch; the current request permits preparation and GitHub updates only.
Owned Apify account, Actor ownership, exact build, current price, billing details, payment method, and KYC state verified through authorized read-only access.
Each proposed distribution route has current verified rules; AI-prohibited forums remain read-only and unknown bot permission is not treated as consent.
A deployed and authorized customer-facing intake with sample-use permission, retention limits, and no unnecessary personal data.
A supported autonomous intake, response, delivery, opt-out, and evidence workflow that does not need daily operator labor.
Actual paid-customer attribution and revenue/cost reconciliation beyond owner-visible run costs and self-reported ledger entries.
Three authorized independent samples and acceptance expectations, before selecting a customer-led feature.
Explicit budget, run caps, and separate approval before any future paid operation or monetization change.
A persistent execution environment and scheduled runner, only if later requested; no schedule exists or is enabled by this manifest.

decisionRules.condition: Current mode is preparation_only or any execution gate is false
decisionRules.action: Produce drafts, local verification, and an explicit missing-readiness list only.

decisionRules.condition: A platform requires identity verification, owner-only account recovery, or other nondelegable account intervention
decisionRules.action: Record the exact dependency and continue independent local preparation; never impersonate the owner or fabricate documents.

decisionRules.condition: At least 3 independent eligible paying customers and at least 1 genuine repeat customer, with successful delivery and measured sustainable unit economics
decisionRules.action: Propose a narrow continuation; do not claim general product-market fit or guaranteed profitability.

decisionRules.condition: Fewer than 20 trustworthy qualified visits or fewer than 5 explicit qualified offers, or missing reliable denominators
decisionRules.action: Do not declare no demand or price rejection. Propose improving permitted inbound discovery and extending the test.

decisionRules.condition: At least 20 qualified visits and 5 explicit qualified offers, reliable delivery, but zero independent eligible paying customers
decisionRules.action: Report the limited tested offer and audience; use actual objections to propose narrowing or revising the offer, not a universal no-demand claim.

decisionRules.condition: Some independent paid use exists but success targets, repeat evidence, eligibility, or material cost evidence are incomplete
decisionRules.action: Report exact counts and missing evidence; propose one bounded follow-up experiment.

decisionRules.condition: Only free users, owner/test purchases, unverified charges, public usage statistics, or expressions of interest exist
decisionRules.action: Separate adoption and interest from paid evidence; assess distribution sufficiency before interpreting the result.

decisionRules.condition: Platform event fees or estimated earnings exist without a settled invoice or actual payout receipt
decisionRules.action: Report provisional revenue, settled earnings, and cash separately. October and November usage can settle in different later monthly cycles.

decisionRules.condition: Channel rules forbid AI content or automated posting, or automation permission is unknown
decisionRules.action: Research public material and prepare owned-channel assets; do not publish, message, or bypass the restriction.
